page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 8 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz. The system features 31.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core, and is equipped with a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture with 16 GB of VRAM. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. This instance does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. The CPU performance is generally modest, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, database operations, Redis SET throughput, and static web serving benchmarks rank in the lower quartile. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong performance in machine learning tasks. LLM inference prompt processing for both 135M and 7B models ranks in the top 10% tier, achieving 8407.18 and 1134.43 tokens per second respectively, while text generation for the 7B model is rated as strong.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the contrast between its weak general-purpose CPU compute capabilities and its highly efficient GPU acceleration. Because local storage is absent, workloads must rely on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy operations. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for specialized workloads that offload computation to the GPU, such as small-to-medium large language model inference, machine learning model deployment, and basic graphics rendering, rather than general-purpose web serving or high-throughput database management.
